name: Estado de Cuenta de Cliente
query:
SELECT
    name,
    posting_date,
    company,
    party_type,
    party,
    account,
    debit,
    credit,
    voucher_type,
    voucher_no
FROM `tabGL Entry`
WHERE party LIKE '%CL-00002%'
   OR party LIKE '%CL00002%'
   OR party LIKE '%CESAR%'
   OR party LIKE '%AUGUSTO%'
   OR party_type LIKE '%Cust%'
ORDER BY posting_date DESC
LIMIT 20;
